question: Should LINE's default webhook ACK policy change from shipped `after_receive_record` to `after_agent_dispatch` so immediate local dispatch rejection returns 500 for provider redelivery?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but this default changes an upgrade-visible provider delivery contract and can intentionally cause LINE redelivery where existing installs previously returned 200.

options.title: Accept after-dispatch default
options.body: Merge the PR's default behavior so dispatch-startup failure is retryable while preserving `after_receive_record` for callers that need the shipped ACK timing.

options.title: Keep shipped default
options.body: Require a small change before merge that leaves `after_receive_record` as the default and makes `after_agent_dispatch` an explicit runtime option.

options.title: Pause for durable queue design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want retryable LINE delivery only after a durable inbound queue or dedupe boundary exists.

recommendation.title: Accept after-dispatch default
recommendation.body: Merge the PR's default behavior so dispatch-startup failure is retryable while preserving `after_receive_record` for callers that need the shipped ACK timing.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the shipped LINE ACK behavior that this PR changes by default.
